title: Page 4
content_zh:
“不会，听你说话很有趣，不像我的生活除了工作还是工作，每天的行程都差不多，说起来都没你一半精彩。”他想她应该没有兴趣听他几点上班、下班、加班，完成了多少投资案，目前又正在筹划哪些合作计划，以及集团未来的组织发展。
从很早以前，他的生活就和工作密不可分，也几乎找不出时间来安插其他跟工作无关的事情，所以在一般人眼中，他的日子绝对都是枯燥乏味的，因此他才可以把发言权交到她身上。
再者，他还可以趁着她说话的时候分神想点公事，连吃饭时他的脑子里也有张工作计划表在运作着。
“你的工作真的很忙耶。”她以一种可以理解的口吻说着，从小看父亲为了事业成天在外头应酬奔波，就能体会他要管理这么庞大的一个集团有多不简单，所以这几年里从没抱怨过他抽不出时间到国外去见她一面，虽然她很想念他，却不敢任性地吵着要他陪。
“谢谢你这么忙还特地抽空去挑礼物送我。”她满怀感谢地说。
“礼物？”他倒有些摸不着头绪。
“对呀，像这个……这是你前年送我的生日礼物，我很喜欢呦。”她从皮包里找出以水晶镶嵌的狗狗造型钥匙圈给他看，上头还配有一颗红色的心型宝石。
她笑盈盈地告诉他自己一直将它视为宝贝地收在身边。每次只要收到他从台湾寄出的礼物，她都会开心得不得了。
“你喜欢就好了。”他扬唇一笑，喝了口水，其实内心是有些心虚的，因为每年记得她生日的人并不是他，而是他的特助，无论是生日礼物、圣诞礼物、结婚纪念日……全都是他的特助替他挑好，以他的名义寄到国外的，只有礼物上附的卡片是出于他笔下，但写的也多是“生日快乐”、“圣诞快乐”、“结婚纪念日快乐”和“保重身体”之类简短无趣的文字。
如今见她满心欢喜地向自己道谢，杜天云心中忽然升起一丝歉疚……对于她手上的那个钥匙圈，他其实没有多少印象。
“只要是你送的我都喜欢。”不知情的她还是笑得很甜，望着他的眸子澄如明镜，照得他良心越来越不安。
“既然如此，我要考考你，你记得我送过哪些礼物给你吗？”他很心机地套她的话，以爽朗的笑容掩饰自己的企图，想从她口中得知自己究竟送过哪些礼物给她，免得日后不小心露出马脚，认不得自己送她的东西。
“当然记得喽，第一年的时候……”她毫无意外地上当，为了表示自己真的有很用心地容它们的特色，还有她把它们摆在哪里、多常使用。
杜天云面带微笑，静静听着她的形容，他发现自己还挺喜欢看着她把每件事物、每个细节都描述得生动无比，说起故事来眉飞色舞的丰富神情。
她滔滔不绝地说着每个礼物的故事，觉得这真是比在公司里听各级主管们简报要有趣得多。
稍晚，在回到杜天云住处的电梯里，关佳颖才知道大约一年半前结婚的杜天海也住在这栋大楼里。因为杜家两老希望他们兄弟俩婚后，不仅能继续在公事上互相扶持，在生活上也能互相有个照应，所以才可以挑了个离公司不远的黄金地段，一口气砸下几亿元的重金，购下整层楼近三百余坪的豪宅，将这一楼两户的住家送给两个儿子当作新婚贺礼，让他们婚后住在对门当邻居。
“……所以他们现在就住在我们对面喽？”电梯门一开，关佳颖望着对门同样气派非凡的大门。
“对。”
“那我要不要过去跟他们打个招呼？”礼貌上她应该去拜访一下他们。
“不急，他们通常早出晚归，在家的时间不一定，遇见了再打声招呼就好了。”虽然兄弟在对门住了快两年，但因为各自的作息时间和生活圈都不同，所以他在公司遇到弟弟的机会还比在自家门前多一点。

有时候杜天海会一个人过来找他串串门子，至于弟媳则是偶尔会在上、下班时和他在电梯里碰到面，彼此点个头打招呼。
“嗯。”老公说不用，关佳颖也就乖乖照办，不去“拜码头”了。
“进来吧。”杜天云替妻子开门，再帮她把行李拿进屋内。
关佳颖在丈夫的引领下大致熟悉了屋内的环境，了解每个星期都会有清洁公司定期派人来替两家进行大范围的打扫，平时则是请了一位阿姨每天早上过来负责准备早餐和整理家务，简单收拾一下环境，如果有需要，也可以请她在离开前先准备好午餐和晚餐预热。
到了就寝时间，关佳颖在浴室里摸了老半天都没出来，心情忐忑得像是抓不准何时要踏出浴室的时机。
一想到要与丈夫同床共枕，她便有种既期待又怕受伤害的心情，因为预料到应该会发生什么，又不很确定什么会怎么发生……害她愈接近揭晓的时刻，心脏就愈是紧张地扑通扑通跳，脑袋里不时跳出一些朦胧的绮丽画面，叫她望着镜中的自己也不禁羞红了脸……
“佳颖，你还好吧？”她在浴室里实在待太久，半点声音都没有，让杜天云开始担心她是不是在里头出了意外。
“哦！我没事。”她惊悸地回答了声，顺了顺长发，吸了口气，终于作足了心理准备，鼓起勇气走出浴室，抬头看着站在门外的丈夫。
“嗨。”她僵硬地微笑，下一秒就懊恼的想咬断自己的舌头。
嗨？她怎么想得出这么愚蠢的开场白？
杜天云看着她有点窘困的表情，一时忍俊不禁，真的被她没道理的反应给逗笑了。
“嗨，准备好要睡觉了吗？”他学她的方式打招呼，觉得她在浴室里好像有很多事要做，怕她还没忙完。
通常杜天云的就寝时间都很准时，如果没被工作耽误，十二点以前一定合眼入眠，清晨六点多就会自动起床，按掉以防万一的闹钟。
“好了。”她娇羞地点点头，准备好要与他共度这迟了三年的新婚之夜，早就决定把自己的人和心都交给他了。
她随他走向床铺。杜天云先上了床，将眼睛摆到一旁的床头柜上，替她掀开被子--
“上来吧。”他面带笑容地说道，望着站在床边，手指轻绞着睡衣一角的妻子，觉得她好像是个第一天转到新班级，紧张得不知如何开口自我介绍的女学生。
也难怪，她才二十五岁，没有太多社会经验，过去一直待在校园里过着单纯的生活，现在却突然搬进这新环境里，成为他的妻，一时间应该不太能适应。
对于这个年纪尚轻，或许对爱情和婚姻都还有些懵懵懂懂，就接受父母安排嫁给他的女孩，他告诉自己要用更多的耐性和爱心对待她，照顾好她的生活起居。
关佳颖望着那张有他的大床，不免还是有些紧张地爬了上去，眼神害羞地看了他一眼，在他身边躺下，静望着天花板。
“关灯喽。”他柔声地说，替她盖上薄被。

因为年纪差了一截，杜天云对她说话的口气总会自动放轻，像在对孩子说话一样。
“嗯。”她轻应了声，误以为那和煦的语气是他对妻子才有的温柔……
她爱他，连他醇厚的声音都喜欢。
content_en:
"No, it's interesting to hear you talk. It's not like my life, which is all about work. My daily schedule is pretty much the same. It's not half as exciting as yours." He thought she wouldn't be interested in hearing what time he went to work, off work, and overtime, how many investment projects he had completed, what cooperation plans he was currently planning, and the future organizational development of the group.
From a long time ago, his life has been inseparable from work, and he can hardly find time to arrange other things that have nothing to do with work. Therefore, in the eyes of ordinary people, his days are absolutely boring, so he can give the right to speak to her.
Besides, he could also take advantage of her to be distracted and think about some business matters. Even while eating, he had a work schedule running in his mind.
"You're really busy at work." She said in an understandable tone. Since she was a child, she has seen her father socializing all day long for his career, so she can understand how difficult it is for him to manage such a huge group. Therefore, in the past few years, she has never complained that he cannot spare time to go abroad to see her. Although she misses him very much, she does not dare to willfully clamor for his company.
"Thank you for being so busy and taking the time to pick out a gift for me." She said with gratitude.
"A gift?" He was a little confused.
"Yes, like this... This is the birthday gift you gave me the year before last. I like it very much." She took out a dog-shaped keychain inlaid with crystals from her purse and showed it to him. It also had a red heart-shaped gemstone on it.
She told him with a smile that she had always kept it as a treasure. Every time she receives a gift from him from Taiwan, she will be extremely happy.
"As long as you like it." He raised his lips and smiled, taking a sip of water. In fact, he felt a little guilty inside, because the person who remembered her birthday every year was not him, but his special assistant. Whether it was birthday gifts, Christmas gifts, wedding anniversaries... they were all his. The special assistant selected the gifts for him and sent them abroad in his name. Only the cards attached to the gifts were written by him, but they were mostly short and boring words such as "Happy Birthday", "Merry Christmas", "Happy Anniversary" and "Take Care".
Now that he saw her thanking him happily, Du Tianyun suddenly felt a sense of guilt in his heart... He actually didn't have much impression of the key ring in her hand.
"As long as it's from you, I like it." Unknowingly, she still smiled sweetly, looking at him with eyes as clear as a mirror, which made his conscience more and more uneasy.
"In this case, I want to test you. Do you remember what gifts I have given you?" He tricked her very deliberately, hiding his intention with a hearty smile, hoping to learn from her what gifts he had given her, so as not to accidentally expose himself in the future and not recognize what he had given her.
"Of course I remember, in the first year..." She was fooled without any surprise, in order to show that she really paid attention to their characteristics, where she placed them and how often she used them.
Du Tianyun smiled and listened quietly to her description. He found that he quite liked watching her describe everything and every detail so vividly and her expressions of joyful expression when she told the story.
She kept telling the story of each gift, thinking it was much more interesting than listening to briefings from executives at all levels in the company.
Later, in the elevator returning to Du Tianyun's residence, Guan Jiaying learned that Du Tianhai, who got married about a year and a half ago, also lived in this building. Because the two elders of the Du family hoped that the two brothers would not only continue to support each other in business, but also take care of each other in life, they chose a prime location not far from the company, spent hundreds of millions of dollars, and purchased a mansion with an entire floor of nearly 300 square meters. They gave the two houses on this floor to their two sons as wedding gifts, and let them live opposite each other after they got married.Residence.
"...So they live across from us now?" As soon as the elevator door opened, Guan Jiaying looked at the equally grand door opposite.
"Yes."
"Then should I go over and say hello to them?" Politely she should pay them a visit.
"There's no rush. They usually leave early and come back late. They don't always have the same time at home. Just say hello when you meet him." Although the brothers have lived across the street for almost two years, because their work schedules and life circles are different, he has more chances to meet his brother at the company than in front of his own home.
Sometimes Du Tianhai would come to him alone to visit him. As for his sister-in-law, she would occasionally meet him in the elevator when going to and from get off work, and they would nod and say hello to each other.
"Yeah." Her husband said no, so Guan Jiaying obediently followed the instructions and stopped going to "pay homage to the dock".
"Come in." Du Tianyun opened the door for his wife, and then helped her take her luggage into the house.
Under the guidance of her husband, Guan Jiaying became familiar with the environment in the house. She learned that every week, a cleaning company regularly sent people to clean the house regularly. Usually, she hired an aunt to come over every morning to prepare breakfast and tidy up the housework, and simply clean up the environment. If necessary, she could also ask her to prepare lunch and warm up dinner before leaving.
When it was time to go to bed, Guan Jiaying stayed in the bathroom for a long time and didn't come out. She felt so uneasy that she couldn't decide when to step out of the bathroom.
When she thought of sharing a bed with her husband, she felt both looking forward to it and afraid of getting hurt, because she expected what would happen, but was not sure how it would happen... As a result, the closer she got to the moment of revelation, the more her heart beat nervously, and some hazy and beautiful pictures popped up in her head from time to time, making her blush when she looked at herself in the mirror...
"Jiaying, are you okay?" She stayed in the bathroom for too long without making any sound, which made Du Tianyun start to worry about whether she had an accident in there.
"Oh! I'm fine." She replied in panic, smoothed her long hair, took a breath, finally made enough mental preparations, mustered up the courage to walk out of the bathroom, and looked up at her husband standing outside the door.
"Hi." She smiled stiffly, and the next second she wanted to bite off her tongue in frustration.
Hi? How could she come up with such a stupid opening line?
Du Tianyun looked at her slightly embarrassed expression and couldn't help but laugh for a moment. He was really amused by her unreasonable reaction.
"Hi, are you ready to go to bed?" He greeted her in the same way, feeling that she had a lot to do in the bathroom and was afraid that she hadn't finished yet.
Du Tianyun usually has a very punctual bedtime. If he is not delayed by work, he will fall asleep before twelve o'clock. He will automatically get up at six o'clock in the morning and press the alarm clock just in case.
"Okay." She nodded coyly, ready to spend the three-year-delayed wedding night with him. She had already decided to give him her life and heart.
She followed him to the bed. Du Tianyun got into bed first, turned his eyes to the bedside table and lifted the quilt for her -
"Come on up." He said with a smile on his face, looking at his wife who was standing by the bed, twirling a corner of her pajamas with her fingers. He felt like she was a female student who was transferred to a new class on her first day and was so nervous that she didn't know how to introduce herself.
It's no wonder that she is only twenty-five years old and doesn't have much social experience. She used to stay on campus and live a simple life. Now she suddenly moved into this new environment and became his wife. She shouldn't be able to adapt to it for a while.
For this girl who was still young and perhaps still a little ignorant about love and marriage, so she accepted her parents' arrangement to marry him, he told himself to treat her with more patience and love and take care of her daily life.
Guan Jiaying looked at the big bed with him, and climbed up nervously. She glanced at him shyly and stood next to him.Lie down and stare at the ceiling.
"Turn off the lights." He said softly and covered her with a thin quilt.
Because of the age difference, Du Tianyun would always speak softly to her, as if he were speaking to a child.
"Yes." She responded softly, mistakenly thinking that the warm tone was the tenderness he had for his wife...
She loved him, even his mellow voice.
